outcome: Feto-maternal interface inflammation (measured by IL-6 and IL-8 concentrations)
cohort: A 3D-printed two-chambered in vitro model of the humanized feto-maternal interface (amnion-decidual) composed of cells and gelatin methacrylate hydrogel material.
finding: IL-10 encapsulated exosomes significantly reduced LPS-induced maternal and fetal inflammatory cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 in the 3D-printed feto-maternal interface model.
